llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究了高氧含量下SLM加工Ti-13Nb-13Zr的工艺，可能影响生物医学植入物的力学性能，但未涉及多孔结构或疲劳测试。
llm.why_not_core: This paper focuses on processing parameters and oxygen effect on densification, but does not address porous structure design, stress shielding, fatigue behavior, or osseointegration.

summary_zh.motivation: 探究高氧气氛对SLM加工Ti-13Nb-13Zr合金致密化和力学性能的影响。
summary_zh.method: 在不同氧含量下进行SLM实验，并表征微观结构和力学性能。
summary_zh.result: 氧含量增加导致致密度降低，但适当氧含量可改善强度。
summary_zh.validation: 通过密度测量、金相观察和拉伸/压缩测试验证。

summary_en.motivation: This study investigates the effect of a relatively high oxygen atmosphere on the densification and mechanical properties of Ti-13Nb-13Zr alloy fabricated by selective laser melting.
summary_en.method: SLM experiments were conducted under controlled oxygen levels, followed by microstructural characterization and mechanical testing.
summary_en.result: Increased oxygen content reduced densification but improved strength within an optimal range.
summary_en.validation: Validation was performed via density measurements, metallographic observation, and tensile/compression tests.

papers.title: Additively Manufactured Multi-Morphology Bone-like Porous Scaffolds: Experiments and Micro-Computed Tomography-Based Finite Element Modeling Approaches
papers.abstract: Tissue engineering, whose aim is to repair or replace damaged tissues by combining the principle of biomaterials and cell transplantation, is one of the most important and interdisciplinary fields of regenerative medicine. Despite remarkable progress, there are still some limitations in the tissue engineering field, among which designing and manufacturing suitable scaffolds. With the advent of additive manufacturing (AM), a breakthrough happened in the production of complex geometries. In this vein, AM has enhanced the field of bioprinting in generating biomimicking organs or artificial tissues possessing the required porous graded structure. In this study, triply periodic minimal surface structures, suitable to manufacture scaffolds mimicking bone's heterogeneous nature, have been studied experimentally and numerically; the influence of the printing direction and printing material has been investigated. Various multi-morphology scaffolds, including gyroid, diamond, and I-graph and wrapped package graph (I-WP), with different transitional zone, have been three-dimensional (3D) printed and tested under compression. Further, a micro-computed tomography (μCT) analysis has been employed to obtain the real geometry of printed scaffolds. Finite element analyses have been also performed and compared with experimental results. Finally, the scaffolds' behavior under complex loading has been investigated based on the combination of μCT and finite element modeling.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文涉及多形态骨支架的设计与力学测试，与AM生物医学方向相关，但缺乏疲劳性能评估。
llm.why_not_core: It does not cover fatigue testing or surface roughness analysis for osseointegration.

summary_zh.motivation: 设计模拟骨异质性的多形态多孔支架并验证其力学性能。
summary_zh.method: 制备三种TPMS结构支架，结合微CT和有限元分析模拟压缩行为。
summary_zh.result: 不同打印方向和材料影响支架力学性能，数值模型与实验吻合良好。
summary_zh.validation: 通过压缩实验和微CT数据对比验证有限元模型。

summary_en.motivation: To design and mechanically characterize multi-morphology porous scaffolds that mimic the heterogeneous nature of bone using additive manufacturing.
summary_en.method: Triply periodic minimal surface scaffolds (gyroid, diamond, I-WP) with graded transitions were 3D printed and tested under compression; micro-CT-based finite element models were developed.
summary_en.result: Printing direction and material significantly influenced mechanical properties, and the finite element simulations showed good agreement with experimental results.
summary_en.validation: Experimental compression tests and micro-CT imaging were used to validate the finite element models.
